one_person_editor_owner.remedy: Owner must explicitly approve organizational exception policy and independent authorized reviewer/approver availability before implementation

reviewer_revoked_before_approval.consequence: No silent role elevation, signature or approval

reviewer_revoked_after_approval_before_d.note: Legally continuing past approvals after reviewer departure is an OPEN decision, test-only conservative hold is not company policy

previously_confirmed_unchanged.note: Subject to existing historical/current print source and settlement gates, never bypass current permissions

changed_existing_bill.note: Keep prior original read-only historic version, do not alter true billing/receivables/receipt/invoices/bank

owner_decisions_required: Which candidate policy is appropriate: independent owner or admin, or independent owner only?
What happens in genuine one-person operations without another reviewer? No automatic self approval.
What is the legal/control meaning of an existing approval after reviewer departure/role revoke?
Should already confirmed/issued/paid old billing retain legacy print, and what is cutover event?
For price changes or discounts, use separate finance approval; do not conflate construction-revision approval with ledger posting.
technical_blockers: No verified server-side JWT/session/AAL2 and current company membership/document ACL authority
No proven approved per-document source from current ERP JSONB state
No signed durable independently authorized audit or policy approval
No actual PDF byte-verified customer delivery nor native print bypass mitigation
No latest SYNCED, independently restorable backup, true customer privacy and all bill/invoice/retention/bank/payroll regressions
No separately signed owner release authorization
test_scope: P40-16BB policy evaluator reused unchanged, fake roster and fake versions only
